title: He kept on the fringe of his line, out of sight of his prefect, out of the reach of the rude feet, feigning to run now and then
html_source: In this paragraph the story shifts to Stephen’s days at Clongowes Woods College. The playground was filled with boys playing, but Stephen keeps to himself. He observes the other boys playing, but does not participate. This expresses Stephen’s alienation. All the other boys are playing on the playground except for him; he is an outsider.
